vehicles.name: Booster 22
vehicles.avid_graphic_note: AVID graphic: cryo 2×, SF 0× (stale — one 33-engine SF confirmed 25 Oct).
vehicles.latest_note: Flew Flight 15 (13 Nov 2026). Ascent and hot-staging succeeded. Boostback ended early due to low fuel mass (root cause not yet published). Guidance aborted the tower catch and diverted the booster offshore. Landing burn, hover, and FTS at landing-burn shutdown. No public FAA mishap statement found as of 25 Nov 2026.

extra_sources.title: SpaceX on X — Super Heavy diverted to an offshore splashdown
SpaceX on X — landing burn and splashdown

vehicles.name: Booster 23
vehicles.avid_graphic_note: AVID graphic: cryo 0, SF 0, stacked (stale — cryo now confirmed).
vehicles.latest_note: Expected partner for Ship 43 on Flight 16 (expected_unofficial; not SpaceX-official). No official Flight 16 date. The unofficial NET 10 Dec 2026 LC-39A Flight 16 target is now in doubt: NASASpaceflight (19 Nov 2026) reported the Cape debut removed from a “high profile missions” slide; Flight 16 may repeat from Starbase while LC-39A could wait for Flight 17.

source.title: NASASpaceflight on X — Cape debut slide change

vehicles.name: Booster 24
vehicles.cryo_detail: First cryogenic proof at Massey's, 22–23 Nov 2026.
vehicles.avid_graphic_note: AVID graphic: stacked (stale — cryo and Massey's rollback after 22–23 Nov).
vehicles.latest_note: Rolled to Massey's 19–20 Nov 2026, completed first cryogenic proof 22–23 Nov 2026, rolled back to the production site with Ship 44 on 23–24 Nov UTC (first ship+booster double rollback). Unofficially tied to Flight 17 (not SpaceX-official).
